children: Valmont Industries reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.1B, up 5.5% year over year, while net income rose 22.2% to $121.05M and diluted EPS increased 25.3% to $6.24. Utility demand supported growth, while agriculture sales declined.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings attributable to Valmont Industries, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Net earnings attributable to Valmont Industries, Inc. per share”.
Infrastructure segment sales grew 9.1% in the quarter, as Utility demand and Coatings volumes offset weaker Telecommunications sales.
Agriculture sales fell 6.4%, with international declines linked to Middle East disruption and softness in Brazil; North America sales rose 15.8%.
Utility capacity expansion supported growth, while higher steel and labor costs and manufacturing variances pressured margins.
Valmont cited continued strong Utility demand amid grid investment and data-center load growth, while agriculture remained exposed to commodity and geopolitical conditions.
